## 🎬 REEL 1 — "Mistake" Hook Formula

**Topic:** Stop buying machine-made zari — here's why hand zari is different

**Reel Script:**

```
HOOK (0-3 seconds):
[Text on screen]
"Zari ke naam pe dhokha mil raha hai market mein"
[Visual: Split screen — machine vs hand zari]

BODY (3-55 seconds):
"Machine se 5 minute mein ban gaya ek design.
Par usme koi jaan nahi hai.

Ab dekho ye — mera haath ka kaam.
3 din laga hain is sherwani pe.
Har taar mein karigar ki mehnat hai.
Har motif mein Ahmedabad ki parampara hai.

Log kehte hain 'zyada mehenga hai'.
Main kehta hoon — 'saste mein achha kahan hai?'

Machine zari: 2 mahine mein nikal aata hai.
Hand zari: 20 saal tak rehta hai.

Aap decide karo."

END (55-60 seconds):
[Same as hook visual — creates loop]
"Zari ke naam pe dhokha mil raha hai market mein"
```

**Caption:**
```
Machine embroidery 5 minute mein ban jata hai. Par zari sirf thread nahi hai — wo ek 500 saal purani kala hai jo karigar ke haathon se zinda rehti hai.

Har stitch mein Ahmedabad ki tradition hai. Har design mein karigar ki rooh hai. Jab aap hand zari khareedte hain, aap sirf kapda nahi khareedte — wo hazaron saal ka hunar khareedte hain jo agle generation tak pahunchta hai.

Kya aap machine-made lenge ya hand-crafted?

#ZariWork #HandEmbroidery #AhmedabadCraft #HandmadeWithLove #ZariKarigar #EthicalFashion
```

## 🎬 REEL 3 — "List" Hook Formula

**Topic:** 5 signs of real hand zari

**Reel Script:**

```
HOOK (0-3 seconds):
[Text on screen]
"5 signs ki aap asli hand zari khareed rahe ho"
[Visual: Close-up of zari work]

BODY (3-55 seconds):
"Number 1: Pattern mein slight variation hoga.
   Machine-made mein sab 100% identical hota hai.
   Hand zari mein — thoda imperfection. Wo perfection hai.

Number 2: Thread ka feel alag hoga.
   Gold thread — asli metal coating lagti hai.
   Machine zari — synthetic shine.

Number 3: Reverse side dekho.
   Clean handwork = smooth reverse.
   Machine work = messy reverse with loose threads.

Number 4: Weight.
   Asli hand zari thoda heavy feel karega.
   Machine zari lightweight, plasticky feel karega.

Number 5: Price.
   Agar 200 rupaye mein mil raha hai — wo hand zari nahi hai.
   Real hand zari = ₹3,000+ minimum for a small piece."

END (55-60 seconds):
[Loop back]
"5 signs ki aap asli hand zari..."
```

**Caption:**
```
Machine zari aur hand zari mein fark jaanna zaroori hai kyunki market mein dhokha bahut hai. Agar aapko ye 5 signs yaad rahenge, kabhi bechara nahi khareedoge.

R Company sirf 100% hand zari banata hai — har piece verified, har thread genuine.

Share this with someone buying a sherwani this season. 💬

#ZariIdentification #HandmadeVsMachine #ZariGuide #AhmedabadiKarigar #EthicalShopping #BridalZari
```

**Best posting time:** Friday 9:00 AM IST
**Length:** 60 seconds
**Format:** Text overlay + close-up shots
